DSC_0149.jpg.title: Down Main Street
DSC_0149.jpg.description: I had to take the crosswalk six times to get this photo. 8:12 PM
DSC_0149.jpg.alt: A view down Main Street from the northern crosswalk at the intersection of Main Street and South Street.

DSC_0152.jpg.title: Rising
DSC_0152.jpg.description: I almost walked past it, but I just couldn't pass it up. 8:13 PM
DSC_0152.jpg.alt: A view of the Saline County Courthouse from Bart Owens & Randy Mooney Memorial Park.

DSC_0155.jpg.title: South Face
DSC_0155.jpg.description: Not the postcard view, but perhaps the most honest one. 8:19 PM
DSC_0155.jpg.alt: A view of the southern side of the Saline County Courthouse from Sevier Street.

DSC_0157.jpg.title: Centered
DSC_0157.jpg.description: The standard 'Greetings from Benton!' shot. 8:20 PM
DSC_0157.jpg.alt: A centered view of the clocktower from the intersection of Main Street and Sevier Street.

DSC_0160.jpg.title: Looking Up
DSC_0160.jpg.description: Standing here made the courthouse seem much taller than it really is. 8:21 PM
DSC_0160.jpg.alt: A view of the clocktower looking up from the war memorial, with the flags centered and visible.

DSC_0161.jpg.title: Allied Glass
DSC_0161.jpg.description: I always thought that sign was painted on for a business that left long ago. 8:22 PM
DSC_0161.jpg.alt: A car passes through the intersection of Main Street and Sevier Street, with the large Allied Glass sign across the street beneath an overcast evening sky.

DSC_0170.jpg.title: Last Light
DSC_0170.jpg.description: One last break in the clouds before the light disappeared. 8:24 PM
DSC_0170.jpg.alt: A work van waits beneath a glowing gap in the evening clouds at a downtown intersection.

DSC_0171.jpg.title: Market Street
DSC_0171.jpg.description: Downtown beginning to wake up for the night. 8:27 PM
DSC_0171.jpg.alt: The Royal Theatre marquee glows over Market Street as dusk settles across downtown Benton.

DSC_0182.jpg.title: United States Post Office
DSC_0182.jpg.description: I wish they had kept using this as the post office. 8:38 PM
DSC_0182.jpg.alt: The historic United States Post Office building illuminated against a blue evening sky.

DSC_0192.jpg.title: After Dark
DSC_0192.jpg.description: The courthouse looked entirely different once the sun disappeared. 8:41 PM
DSC_0192.jpg.alt: The Saline County Courthouse clocktower viewed from Main Street after nightfall.

DSC_0203.jpg.title: Red Eyes
DSC_0203.jpg.description: That neon clock is a little hard to read from there, even if it was accurate. 8:43 PM
DSC_0203.jpg.alt: The glowing red neon street clock seen across downtown Benton at night.

DSC_0206.jpg.title: Passing Through
DSC_0206.jpg.description: It was late, but there were still some people out. 8:43 PM
DSC_0206.jpg.alt: A vehicle passes beneath streetlights with the courthouse visible in the background.

DSC_0213.jpg.title: Intersection
DSC_0213.jpg.description: Since it was dark out and there were very few cars, I actually got in the street for this one. I think it was worth it instead of having to use the crosswalk six times. 8:44 PM
DSC_0213.jpg.alt: A nighttime view across the intersection of Main Street and Sevier Street.

DSC_0214.jpg.title: Outline
DSC_0214.jpg.description: This was the first time I saw this building with the new sign up after they switched from RE/MAX. 8:44 PM
DSC_0214.jpg.alt: The lpt realty building outlined in patriotic lights beneath a cloudy night sky.

DSC_0222.jpg.title: Lighthouse
DSC_0222.jpg.description: From here, it looks like the streetlight is brighter than the truck's headlights. 8:48 PM
DSC_0222.jpg.alt: A bright downtown streetlight illuminating South Street at night.

DSC_0248.jpg.title: Around the Corner
DSC_0248.jpg.description: I've always had a fascination with the Royal Theatre. It's one of my favorite subjects to photograph. 8:55 PM
DSC_0248.jpg.alt: The neon-lit Royal Theatre is seen across Main Street, framed by a brick wall in the foreground.

DSC_0251.jpg.title: Steeple
DSC_0251.jpg.description: Looking north on what's easily my favorite street in downtown Benton: Market Street. 8:56 PM
DSC_0251.jpg.alt: A nighttime view west along Market Street with storefronts and a church steeple.

DSC_0260.jpg.title: Twin Towers
DSC_0260.jpg.description: One of the first things you see coming into downtown from Military, and one of the last you see leaving downtown via Military. 9:18 PM
DSC_0260.jpg.alt: The Benton Municipal Waterworks water towers illuminated against the night sky.

DSC_0263.jpg.title: Vacancy
DSC_0263.jpg.description: This CVS has been closed for years, just waiting for the next tenant. Isn't it kind of ironic that the only visible reflection is from a competitor? 9:19 PM
DSC_0263.jpg.alt: An empty CVS viewed through large storefront windows at night.

DSC_0273.jpg.title: Commercial Strip
DSC_0273.jpg.description: The familiar glow of late-night Benton. I used to love driving down here with my parents as a kid. 9:24 PM
DSC_0273.jpg.alt: The Wendy's sign and surrounding businesses illuminated along Military Road at night.
